title: 夜宴左氏庄
author: 杜甫
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE full-bleed 9:16 portrait illustration for a premium Chinese poetry reader. Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. The central and lower 65% must be almost blank warm ivory writing paper for separately rendered poem text. No strong shapes below that area; tiny pale motifs at outermost bottom corners only if truly needed. Specific scene: A spring-night gathering at a country house: two scholars with books, qin and a sheathed sword, low candles, stars reflected in a flower-bordered stream; hints of a small boat beyond.
Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 夜宴左氏庄 — 杜甫
风林纤月落，衣露净琴张。
暗水流花径，春星带草堂。
检书烧烛短，看劒引杯长。
诗罢闻吴咏，扁舟意不忘。
visualReview: 草堂夜宴两人、古琴书卷、入鞘剑、烛光与春星相互对应；主体在顶部，河水自然化雾，留白区完整。
